in_marathi.name: Kartick
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of agriculture and wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kartick हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kartick is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘Krishna’ (कृष्ण) meaning ‘dark-complexioned’ and ‘Karta’ (कार्ता) meaning ‘the potter’ or ‘maker’. This name is associated with Lord Kartikeya, the Hindu god of war, agriculture, and wealth.

This name is associated with Lord Kartikeya, the Hindu god of war, agriculture, and wealth.
